description: Scoring configuration for PrepVista. Defines how the 14 question categories roll up into 7 placement-readiness pillars, the weight each pillar carries in the 0-100 Placement Readiness Index (PRI), the score tiers and their thresholds, the per-category 'ready' cutoffs, and the difficulty weights. scoring.py and the growth/TPO dashboards read this so the readiness model is configurable, not hardcoded.

pillars.label: Technical Competence
pillars.description: Depth in the candidate's domain and the ability to talk credibly about their own work.

pillars.label: Aptitude & Logic
pillars.description: Quantitative, logical, and lateral reasoning under time pressure.

pillars.label: Problem Solving & Analysis
pillars.description: Structured thinking on open-ended business, case, and estimation problems.

pillars.label: Communication & Articulation
pillars.description: Getting heard, engaging in discussion, and asking sharp questions.

pillars.label: Behavioral & Interpersonal
pillars.description: Past-behaviour stories and situational judgement, well-structured and honest.

pillars.label: Composure & Adaptability
pillars.description: Staying calm and thinking clearly under stress and curveballs.

pillars.label: Professional Maturity
pillars.description: Genuine motivation, cultural fit, and a mature approach to the offer conversation.

pri.pillar_score: Mean of the category mean-scores (each 0-10) within the pillar, multiplied by 10 to a 0-100 scale.
pri.formula: PRI = sum(pillar_score_0_100 * pri_weight) across all pillars.
pri.note: Category scores are difficulty-weighted means of question scores; recent sessions are weighted more (see overall_score.recency_half_life_days).

score_tiers.label: Platinum
score_tiers.meaning: Placement-ready across the board; among the strongest candidates.

score_tiers.label: Gold
score_tiers.meaning: Strong and interview-ready, with only minor gaps to polish.

score_tiers.label: Silver
score_tiers.meaning: Competitive, but a few areas need focused work before peak season.

score_tiers.label: Bronze
score_tiers.meaning: Foundations are forming; needs consistent practice across categories.

score_tiers.label: Developing
score_tiers.meaning: Early stage; prioritise fundamentals and regular mock practice.

overall_score.method: Difficulty-weighted mean of individual question scores (0-10).
overall_score.note: A question's contribution is weighted by difficulty_weights[difficulty]; older sessions decay with a 30-day half-life so the score reflects current readiness.
